title: ononis repens var. procurrens
intro: Ononis repens var. procurrens, commonly known as Creeping Restharrow, is a plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in the treatment of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Creeping Restharrow include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential remedy for gastrointestinal issues and urinary problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may contribute to its potential therapeutic effects.
